entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer and official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud or self-hosted OSS. It features multi-level state management for users and sessions using time-aware hybrid retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine with sub-300ms recall. It automates fact extraction and integrates with external connectors like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official AGPL-3.0 context database that utilizes a three-tier loading system to significantly reduce token costs. It organizes memories via a filesystem-based structure and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that synthesizes cited answers with explicit gap analysis. It employs a self-wiring knowledge graph to handle complex entity relationships and supports scoped multi-user institutional memory.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A long-term memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for continuous learning. It acts as an LLM wrapper that automates storage and retrieval across providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from conversations to build stateful agents. It uses peer-centric modeling and hybrid BM25/vector search to track evolving ideas.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that treats memory as a git repository, enabling versioning via commit, branch, and merge operations. It offers a 5-tier retrieval system and cloud sync for team knowledge sharing.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that uses iterative improvement loops and real-world scoring to help agents master complex tasks. It generates persistent playbooks and artifacts to optimize future agent runs.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system utilizing a single-file SQLite architecture for sub-millisecond retrieval. It offers 9.4x episodic storage compression and native MCP support for Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG to compact history without losing messages. It provides tools to search and expand historical summaries while preserving raw messages in SQLite.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend that brings cross-session persistence to Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server for private memory management.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It features a repairable memory system for editing or reclassifying agent context via SQLite.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open YAML engram format to eliminate API costs. It employs ACT-R activation to strengthen relevant facts while decaying stale information.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It combines BM25, vector search, and knowledge graphs via an MCP server integration.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases prefill speeds by 1.5–3× through prefix cache reuse. It reduces prompt token usage by approximately 36% and includes native plugin support for Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via 'why_retrieved' tags. It tracks contradictions and canonicalizes duplicates without requiring a separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It utilizes a multi-layered storage approach with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to reduce prompt noise.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system combining semantic search with ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes local directories, URLs, and multimedia files using edge tags for navigable relationships.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses a local-first SQLite-vec and GGUF architecture delivered via an MCP-native server.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces tool-schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tools. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database with importance-weighted recall. It surfaces high-priority memories first and supports optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of events to prevent outdated summaries from haunting recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for all memory operations.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that generates prototypes, motion graphics, and decks. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and supports over 100 skills and 261 plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 754 cybersecurity skills mapped to major frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It follows the agentskills.io standard for seamless discovery across various AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Converts natural language descriptions and codebases into .drawio XML diagrams. It supports a wide array of presets including UML, ERD, and Architecture, utilizing over 10,000 official shapes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through background evolution loops. It unifies skill libraries across teams and devices with native Hermes integration.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place modes. It uses a two-pass detection system and 49 pattern categories to ensure human-like content.
entries.wondelai/skills: A modular, cross-platform skills library based on industry guidelines and established frameworks. It allows for easy installation via npx or a dedicated plugin marketplace.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure to reduce token usage. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Enables Hermes Agent to extract transcripts, captions, and timestamps from YouTube without using yt-dlp. It also supports channel browsing, video search, and playlist extraction.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and one-click installation of skills, featuring automated security scanning with 65+ threat detection rules. It includes a creator marketplace with crypto and Stripe payment support.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts using dynamic 'prisms' for resilience and optimization. It includes a reflection tool to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A set of workflow skills that transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes with a PASS/FAIL evaluation gate for spec reviews.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A local-first Rust binary that manages long-running agents through a durable card model for task and decision tracking. It ensures quality via evidence-backed QA gates before shipping work.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Implements literate programming by weaving code and documentation into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io-compliant tools for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agentskills.io skills. It ensures accuracy through pinned commits and exact file:line citations.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official skill set for FLUX image generation, providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks, polling, and JSON structured prompting.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry of reusable AI skills featuring a Python client and CLI for versioned installation. It supports recursive dependency resolution and commerce via Stripe and TON payment rails.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery from failures.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token consumption. It features a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and hot-reloading configurations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Integrates Hermes Agent with Nextcloud via WebDAV and CalDAV to manage files, calendars, and contacts. It uses secure HTTPS communication and includes a guided setup script.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure and integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: Rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram based on model reasoning capabilities. It tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and exploits. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by focusing on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to safely modify code and detect concurrency anti-patterns.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system that uses FTS5, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion to find the best skills. It reduces token usage by filtering large skill libraries down to the five most relevant options.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across multiple protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, with daily automatic updates to ensure the latest features are always available. It enables instant execution via nix run commands, making it a highly efficient choice for developers who prefer reproducible environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on Android devices via Termux. It specifically targets ARM64 hardware and leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to bridge the gap between agent CLIs and smartphone hardware.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This zero-install Windows desktop solution provides a portable environment for Hermes Agent with over 100 built-in tools and local model support via LM Studio. It features a dynamic tool maker and workflow engine, allowing users to build custom automation pipelines without needing Docker or complex installations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent on Android through Termux with support for over 200 AI models. It is optimized for mobile use with persistent memory and a suite of 70 integrated tools for local or cloud-based execution.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates cloud-native Hermes deployments on Kubernetes with a focus on state safety and persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a high-security sandbox for Hermes Agent that uses hardware-level enforcement to block dangerous syscalls and network egress. It allows for dynamic security policies ranging from strict to permissive while integrating seamlessly with IDEs and MCP servers.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that includes both the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific versions of the agent using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative management of Hermes Agent configurations, documents, and systemd services for fully reproducible deployments. It prioritizes security through sops-nix integration for secrets handling and supports a hybrid model for both Nix-managed and interactive CLI skills.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless environments, this project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian. It is specifically built to enable autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with the Nous Portal.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for orchestrating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with its own workspace and identity. It features hierarchy-aware delegation for inter-agent tasks and provides enterprise-grade MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: This deployment option provides a Docker Compose stack managed via Portainer that includes a ttyd web terminal for remote browser-based access. It utilizes GitHub Actions for automated image builds, ensuring a streamlined setup for users who prefer GUI-based container management.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration stack that uses a zero-dependency SQLite backend to dispatch tasks and monitor spend. It provides multi-gateway support for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, featuring an Aegis review system for quality control.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project offers a TUI and PWA dashboard to monitor diverse coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, within isolated sandboxes. It enables parallel execution by leveraging git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A tiered architecture template designed to scale from a single VPS agent to full specialist teams. It utilizes a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control-room template uses a level-based architecture to transition from individual agents to automated, orchestrated workflows. It features a task bus for specialist handoffs and includes skills for VPS provisioning and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: An orchestration platform for building autonomous swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenRouter. It provides visual org charts, durable agent memory, and support for scheduled runs.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A centralized mission control interface that uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task statuses and review queues. It allows users to live-stream agent reasoning and perform human-in-the-loop verification on all completed tasks.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents through a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to manage tool handling and agent dialogue flows via a Kanban interface.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A specialized pipeline for end-to-end software development featuring 17 distinct agents for roles like research, implementation, and infrastructure. The system enforces mandatory quality gates through dedicated reviewer and tester agents.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization tool that uses automated outer-loop search to refine Hermes Agent harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers through structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. The platform orchestrates nine agents, including Hermes, and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize tasks and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: A delegation tool that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style workflows. It prevents parent context pollution through isolation and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local pre-indexed knowledge graph of symbol relationships and call graphs that auto-syncs on file changes. It optimizes Hermes Agent's performance by significantly reducing the number of tool calls and tokens required for code navigation.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A high-performance Rust-based TUI designed to aggregate and track token costs across multiple AI clients. It allows developers to monitor spending and usage metrics for Hermes, Gemini, and Claude in a single interface.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables deep inspection of API traffic, including system prompts and tool schemas. It features structured diffs for comparing requests and allows users to export sessions as portable HTML files for analysis.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that orchestrates autonomous CTO loops for issue triage and deployment. It extends Hermes Agent with 23 specialized skills and native integrations for Vercel, Supabase, and Sentry.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-driven CLI themes that customize the Hermes terminal UI with ASCII art and unique color schemes. It supports partial configurations via inheritance, allowing users to mix default settings with aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and its 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel. It eliminates the need for OAuth or external processes while adding specialized MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser that grants autonomous agents control via MCP while maintaining a human-visible UI for real-time supervision. It features durable state management with action undo and agent-specific bookmarks.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations. It allows developers to seamlessly switch between global and project-local memories, tools, and instructions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through optimized CLI workflows. It comes with 40+ pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A rapid deployment stack that uses Docker to launch Hermes Agent with LiteLLM, Ollama, and Qdrant. It provides a zero-cost environment featuring 29 community plugins for memory and quality validation using local GPU inference.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter that scans agent configs and system prompts for failure modes using HERM v1.1 scoring. It integrates into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, free scanning without requiring any LLM calls.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A dedicated migration utility that transfers personas, memories, and skills from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps complex model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles the transfer of system-level credentials.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that provides native performance for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that unifies Hermes Agent and 13+ other CLI agents into a single GUI. It features a built-in engine for web search and MCP integration, with the ability to automatically generate editable Word, Excel, and Morph PPT files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A zero-build web interface using Python and vanilla JavaScript that offers full feature parity with the Hermes Agent CLI. It utilizes a three-panel layout to organize chat, sessions, and workspace file browsing for use on web or mobile.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to guide the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent environments. It supports multiple AI providers and local OpenAI-compatible endpoints, integrating with 14 specialized toolsets and 16 messaging gateways.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard focused on multi-platform configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp. It provides local session management via SQLite and multi-profile control for managing credentials, skills, and memory.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal and Monaco editor for full file browsing. It introduces Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside an integrated MCP catalog and memory browser.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that connects directly via SSH without the need for browser wrappers or daemons. It provides dedicated views for Kanban, cron jobs, and skills, supporting multiple Hermes profiles on universal macOS architecture.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring the ZOO Swarm Monitor with a kanban pipeline and live event feed. It provides a full MCP server control plane with log tailing and a browser-based terminal for agent stack management.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that indexes Hermes and other coding agents locally without telemetry. It includes a specialized Limits Widget to predict usage for Claude and Codex.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface specifically for Hermes Agent instances running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It enables one-click automated installation on cloud VMs and integrates WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first Chinese desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It includes a built-in kernel for installation and health checks, with native support for LaTeX, Mermaid rendering, and MCP tools.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for managing profiles, memory, and cron jobs. It facilitates agentic workflows through integrated task diagnostics and kanban boards within a rich markdown-supported chat interface.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It allows for terminal chat with streaming responses and the management of background agent spawning and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no Docker or admin rights. It bundles over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen, and includes a dynamic tool maker for creating Python handlers and API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A self-hosted, glassmorphic web interface delivered as a single-file React 18 HTML application. It integrates a terminal and file browser with real-time monitoring for agent logs, tasks, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard that provides a real-time activity feed via WebSockets. It offers FTS5 search for session history and read-only access to environment variables and config.yaml.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for installing MCP servers and skills, with isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a PM orchestrator for managing streaming chat responses.
